claims: 2026 Women's Selection Sunday took place on March 15, 2026.
2026 Women's Selection Sunday set the 68-team NCAA Tournament field.
UConn Huskies earned the No. 1 overall seed.
UConn Huskies had an undefeated regular season.
UConn headlines the Fort Worth 1 region.
Regional #1 seeds are UConn, Texas, UCLA, South Carolina.
Selection Show was on Sunday, March 15, 8 p.m. ET on ESPN.
Regional Rounds (Sweet 16/Elite Eight) on March 27–30 in Fort Worth, Texas, and Sacramento, California.
Final Four on April 3 & 5 at the Mortgage Matchup Center in Phoenix, Arizona.
UConn Huskies named No. 1 overall seed for the 11th time in program history.
UConn Huskies have a 50-game win streak.
UConn Huskies face UTSA in the first round.
Texas Longhorns secured a No. 1 seed with a 31-3 record.
South Carolina and UCLA secured top spots in the bracket.
Top 16 teams were announced prior to the full reveal.
NCAA.com reports this is the first tournament utilizing the 2026-2031 future site structure with the Final Four in Phoenix.
